slice: candidate_context app scaffold, immutable CandidateContextSnapshot, direct-match bucket
objective: Create the candidate_context Django app (V2-D030) as a distinct app from candidate_memory. Add CandidateContextSnapshot: an immutable-per-run snapshot model referencing the StageRun that produced it (StageIdentifier.CANDIDATE_CONTEXT_BUILD from job_applications.models — a deterministic stage that never receives a StageModelAssignment and has no provider/model FK). Resolve the interim target-job input using ONLY JobApplication.employer and JobApplication.job_title (no job_intake / AJ dependency — that app does not exist yet and is M4 scope; this is a deliberate interim choice recorded as V2-D047, not a workaround). Implement the first of the five context buckets, direct_match: deterministic (non-LLM) retrieval of MemoryClaim rows whose category is in {CAREER_HISTORY, SKILL, ACHIEVEMENT} and whose text/tags show keyword/lexical overlap with the target job's employer/job_title signal, with a bounded fail-closed selection budget (simple deterministic scoring only — no BM25 or ranking library; matches CTX-001 minimum-sufficient context, not exhaustive retrieval). CandidateContextSnapshot schema must include fields/placeholders for all five buckets (direct_match, differentiators, career_narrative, foundations, gaps_constraints per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §7 / V2-D003); only direct_match is populated by this slice — empty/placeholder values for the other four are expected. Governed by CTX-001, CTX-002, CTX-006, V2-D003, V2-D025, V2-D030, V2-D047, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §§3–5/7, docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md M3B, and docs/TEST_STRATEGY.md Candidate context.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1/CTX-001: after ingest_default_candidate_sources against a real candidate profile, building CandidateContextSnapshot for at least two distinct JobApplication fixtures with different employer/job_title (The two required JobApplication test fixtures must be constructed from tests/fixtures/job_postings/acme_widget_systems_engineer.md (employer/job_title matching Employer: Acme Widget Co (fictional) / Role: Systems Engineer) and tests/fixtures/job_postings/globex_platform_lead.md (employer/job_title matching Employer: Globex Platforms Ltd (fictional) / Role: Platform Lead); parse those committed files or hardcode matching values — implementer's choice — but the two employer/job_title pairs used in tests must match those two committed fixture files, not arbitrary invented strings) yields non-empty direct_match evidence that is category-filtered, lexically driven, budget-bounded, and deterministically ordered — not merely non-empty. Specifically: (a) only MemoryClaim rows with category in {CAREER_HISTORY, SKILL, ACHIEVEMENT} may appear in direct_match; claims in any other category must be excluded even when present in the ingested profile; (b) selection must be driven by real keyword/lexical overlap between claim text/tags and the JobApplication.employer/job_title signal — not 'first N claims', not 'all claims', and not an order-independent dump of the allowed categories; (c) a documented bounded selection budget is enforced fail-closed: when more claims match than the budget allows, the result respects the cap and never returns the unfiltered full match set; (d) the same inputs produce the same selected claim set in the same deterministic/repeatable order. Note: no real job posting body text exists in this repo yet (docs/QUALITY_BENCHMARK.md Amazon GenAI Solutions Architect remains a placeholder) — use those two committed fixture-derived JobApplication employer/job_title pairs, not fabricated 'real' postings and not arbitrary invented strings

AC-2/CTX-006: CandidateContextSnapshot is immutable at the model layer after creation (same class of guarantee as AUDIT-002 / candidate_memory/integrity.py HardIntegrityError/IntegrityFinding), not merely create-only at the service layer. After creation, CandidateContextSnapshot must reject Model.save()-based field mutation and Model.delete(), and must also reject QuerySet.update() and QuerySet.delete() bypass paths; a re-run creates a new snapshot row referencing a new StageRun and never mutates or deletes an existing row. A create-only service sitting on an ordinarily-mutable Django model does not satisfy this criterion

AC-3/V2-D030: candidate_context is a read-only consumer of candidate_memory at runtime — never creates, modifies, or deletes MemoryClaim, CareerEngagement, CandidateProfile, StaticResumeProfile, or ExperienceSlot rows as a side effect of building a snapshot. Enforcement must be a runtime test that exercises the real candidate_context build path (ingest fixtures, build a CandidateContextSnapshot) and then asserts zero create/modify/delete side effects on those candidate_memory models; a static import-boundary check alone does not satisfy this criterion

AC-4/CTX-001 sensitivity + filtering: changing which of the two committed-fixture-derived JobApplication employer/job_title pairs (acme_widget_systems_engineer.md vs globex_platform_lead.md) is used changes the direct_match bucket's selected claims (job-signal sensitivity without AJ). In addition, required negative/bound cases must pass: (a) a claim that does NOT lexically match the job signal is excluded even when its category is in {CAREER_HISTORY, SKILL, ACHIEVEMENT}; (b) a claim that is NOT in an allowed category is excluded even when its text/tags would otherwise match the job signal; (c) a synthetic profile with more matching claims than the selection budget still respects the cap and does not return everything unfiltered; (d) repeated builds with identical inputs yield identical ordered selections

AC-5/CTX-002 schema: CandidateContextSnapshot exposes fields/placeholders for all five buckets; only direct_match is populated; the other four remain empty/placeholder values as expected for this slice
AC-6/deterministic stage: producing StageRun uses StageIdentifier.CANDIDATE_CONTEXT_BUILD with null provider/model FKs; no StageModelAssignment and no live provider call

AC-7/V2-D047: docs/DECISIONS.md gains new entry V2-D047 recording interim JobApplication.employer/job_title target-job signal (consistent with docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §7 separable candidate_memory vs current-job/AJ input classes; richer AJ input lands in M4 without redesign); docs/CURRENT_STATE.md and docs/REQUIREMENT_TRACEABILITY.md reflect implemented slice state for CTX-001/CTX-002/CTX-006
